name: Hunt Grounds
description:
About This Game

Survive atmospheric solo and co-op horror scenarios while being hunted by unnatural entities in Hunt Grounds.
Each scenario features unique locations, objectives, and supernatural threats designed around tension, exploration, and survival.

Each scenario features unique locations, objectives, and supernatural threats designed around tension, exploration, and survival.

Solo & Co-op Horror

Play alone or with a friend as you navigate immersive horror scenarios filled with environmental interaction, hidden paths, and dangerous encounters.

Hide from roaming entities, search abandoned locations, unlock new areas, and survive long enough to escape.

Features

  • Solo and co-op horror gameplay

  • Atmospheric survival horror scenarios

  • Environmental interaction and puzzle solving

  • Hiding and exploration mechanics

  • Unnatural entities with unique behaviors

  • Supernatural tools to aid your survival

  • Replayable horror encounters
